bound_definition: product_digest = sha256 of canonical JSON (separators ',',':', ensure_ascii=False, keys n/a) of the sorted rows [[posix_relative_path, sha256_file], ...] over PRODUCT_ROOTS=["src", "tests", "tools", "schemas", "dist", "docs", "skills", "fixtures", "pyproject.toml", "README.md", "ACCEPTANCE.md", "LICENSE", "PROVENANCE.md", "SBOM.cdx.json", "OWNER_LICENSE_DECISION.yaml", "openspec"], excluding any path with a part in EXCLUDE_DIRS=[".agents", ".git", ".hermes", ".hgk", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"] or a suffix in EXCLUDE_SUFFIX=[".pyc", ".pyo"].

rejected_alternative.why_rejected: narrower scope: omits packaging/legal/openspec roots, so two of the round's own scripts published different numbers for the same subject (challenge C8)
